pages.text: $(bold)Item Levels$()$(br2)All equipment begins its journey at $(thing)Level 1$() (0–99 XP).$(br2)By using weapons, tools, and armor in combat or tasks, you earn experience for them. Leveling up grants stronger base attributes and unlocks additional bonus slots.

$(bold)Rarity & Quality$()$(br2)An item's rarity determines its maximum potential, reforge limit, and header color (from $(7)Common$() to $(d)Divine$()).$(br2)The stars below the header indicate the item's $(thing)Quality$(). Higher quality directly increases its stat modifiers.

$(bold)Reforging$()$(br2)An item's stats and quality can be altered at the $(thing)Runic Table$().$(br2)Each item has a limited number of reforge charges. However, you can reset the reforge count using a $(item)Cleansing Cloth$()!
The $(item)Cleansing Cloth$() resets the item's reforge charges back to maximum.
